arguments.body:
PR coverage currently requires manually running `sun pr --update`. Extend the optional shell integration to add coverage after successful `gh pr create` and refresh matching existing PRs after successful Git and Sun publication.

- Wrap `gh` alongside `git`, preserving interactive creation and the original command's exit status. Identify the new PR by branch, Git commit, and creation time; target edits by URL.
- Add `--no-sun-pr` to either wrapped command, plus independent persistent `sun shell-init --no-gh-pr` and `--no-git-pr` opt-outs. Opting out of PR coverage does not disable Sun history sharing.
- Preserve the description outside the Sun section. Automatic updates use recorded checks without syncing dirty files or extracting new chat verdicts. Add `sun pr --update --pr URL` for explicit targeting.

Automatic updates require an initialized Sun repository with rules and authenticated gh. They cover the checked-out branch at the matching Git commit. Browser creation, dry runs, other local branches, and push-triggered updates across fork/base repositories are skipped; manual updates remain available. Coverage failures warn without failing a successful create or push.

Validation: 15 targeted tests passed across the PR integration, existing Git integration, and PR summary rendering. Tests use real local Git repositories and a stub gh executable, covering opt-outs, targeting, body preservation, dirty-file preservation, failure handling, and stale-head protection.

- Wrap `gh` alongside `git`, preserving interactive creation and the original command's exit status. Identify the new PR by branch, Git commit, and creation time; target edits by URL.
- Add `--no-sun-pr` to either wrapped command, plus independent persistent `sun shell-init --no-gh-pr` and `--no-git-pr` opt-outs. Opting out of PR coverage does not disable Sun history sharing.
- Preserve the description outside the Sun section. Automatic updates use recorded checks without syncing dirty files or extracting new chat verdicts. Add `sun pr --update --pr URL` for explicit targeting.

Automatic updates require an initialized Sun repository with rules and authenticated gh. They cover the checked-out branch at the matching Git commit. Browser creation, dry runs, other local branches, and push-triggered updates across fork/base repositories are skipped; manual updates remain available. Coverage failures warn without failing a successful create or push.

Validation: 15 targeted tests passed across the PR integration, existing Git integration, and PR summary rendering. Tests use real local Git repositories and a stub gh executable, covering opt-outs, targeting, body preservation, dirty-file preservation, failure handling, and stale-head protection.
